title: Drive health
demo: DEMO · example drives, not live readings
stale: Readings unavailable or over two hours old
empty: No SSD readings yet. Install and start the collector; see README.
writesUnrated: Written: %1 TB · endurance limit not configured
note: Wear estimates and warranty limits do not predict a failure date.
readError: Could not read the health report
notSeen: Drive not read this time · showing last readings
historyNote: Between each day’s first and last sample; gaps are not estimated.
historyEmpty: First reading recorded. Daily totals appear after more samples.
reason.smart_failed: The drive reports a SMART health failure.
reason.critical_warning: The NVMe controller reports a critical warning.
reason.nvme_spare: Available spare capacity is below the drive’s threshold.
reason.nvme_temperature: The drive reports a temperature outside its permitted range.
reason.nvme_readonly: The controller reports that the media is read-only.
reason.nvme_backup: The controller reports failure of its volatile-memory backup.
reason.wear_high: Estimated wear is at least 90%: the widget’s planning threshold.
reason.ata_threshold: A current ATA pre-failure attribute is at or below its threshold.
reason.ata_past_threshold: An ATA attribute crossed its threshold in the past.
reason.error_log: The device error log contains recorded errors.
reason.selftest_log: The device self-test log contains a failure record.
reason.read_incomplete: Some SMART information could not be read.
reason.not_seen: The drive was not read in this collection.
observation.baseline: Already present at the first recorded observation of this counter (%1). Its earlier history is unknown.
observation.increased: Counter increased by %1 since the reading at %2.
observation.decreased: Counter decreased since %1; comparison baseline restarted. This does not establish that a fault was repaired.
observation.note: Times refer to observations, not when a fault actually occurred.
settingsHelp: Find your exact SSD model and capacity on the manufacturer’s website. Look for “Endurance” or “TBW” in its specifications, and use the warranty terms with your purchase date to determine the warranty end date. Leave a field blank if unknown.
settingsDemo: Demo mode: settings are not saved.
settingsError.invalid_date: Enter a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or leave it blank.
settingsError.invalid_tbw: Enter a positive TBW value up to 1,000,000,000, or leave it blank.
settingsError.invalid_id: This drive cannot be identified. Close and reopen the panel.
settingsError.invalid_config: The existing settings file is invalid. It has not been overwritten.
settingsError.write_failed: Could not save settings. Check that your configuration folder is writable.
settingsError.invalid_request: Could not save settings in this mode.
